abstract: A male infant, born following an uncomplicated pregnancy, was severely anaemic at birth following significant foeto-maternal haemorrhage. At three weeks of age a tumour was found in the liver with evidence of metastatic disease in the lungs. The infant died before treatment could be started. Postmortem revealed choriocarcinoma which led to subsequent diagnosis in the mother who also had pulmonary metastases. The mother has been successfully treated. The case is described in detail and followed by a discussion and a literature review of reported cases of simultaneous choriocarcinoma in infant and mother.
abstract_ja: 男児乳児は、妊娠経過に問題なく出生したが、胎児母体間出血により出生時に高度の貧血を呈した。生後3週時に肝腫瘍と肺転移の所見が認められた。治療開始前に乳児は死亡した。剖検で絨毛癌と診断され、これにより母親の診断に至った。母親にも肺転移があったが、治療に成功した。本稿では本症例を詳細に記載し、母児同時発症の絨毛癌について報告例の文献的考察を行った。
